# E0233: a minor version's disjunction cannot be proven to cover its predecessor's

The checker shows a disjunction compatible by finding, for each alternative of
the predecessor, one alternative of the new schema that covers it. Alternatives
that cover it only together are not combined, so the checker cannot decide.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				n: >=0 | <0
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0233]: n in schema v0.1 is now >=0 | <0, no single alternative of which covers the prior alternative int; the checker does not combine alternatives
  --> lineage.cue:11:5
   |
11 |                 n: >=0 | <0
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema v0.1 is a minor version, so it must accept all data schema v0.0 accepts
   = help: change the schema so the checker can decide, or make this version v1.0
```
